did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. There were no memos that held both Napa 500 mg and Seclo 20 mg. At the counter five retail sales (memos M2026-000036 to M2026-000040) were made, each with one box of Napa and Seclo. A shopper then opened the Napa page.

checks.text: The Napa page shows "People who bought this also took" with Seclo 20 mg (picture, form, price 720.00 a box)
The row only appears when enough different memos agree (5 by default), so one buyer's basket is never shown; before the five memos there was no row

notes: Done by hand in the live browser, not by a script. The five sales were made quickly by pressing the buttons on the counter page. The "at least 5 memos" rule is a setting with no screen of its own.
